EXPLANATION: The medium band at 2728 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of an aldehydic/formyl C–H band arising via Fermi resonance with a bending overtone, a hallmark of –CHO/formate groups (SPC-002). Among the candidates, only hexyl formate (3) contains a formyl hydrogen. The strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2879–2906 cm⁻¹ and CH2 scissoring at 1442 cm⁻¹ fit a saturated alkyl chain (GFQ-003). The 1078 cm⁻¹ band matches a C–O stretch typical for ester/ether linkages present in 3. Absence of bands near 2100–2250 cm⁻¹ disfavours nitrile/azide-containing candidates. The 894 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with C–O–C/formyl-related deformation.
